name: Sylvan-Mastaba

civilization.name: Ysolde Dominion
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around an ancient meteor crater, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.

The colonists of the monolithic structures of unknown origin kept meticulous logs right up to the final entry, which is a shopping list. Rescue charters still quote the coordinates, and still decline the contract.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
